DIXON.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
DIXON.about: India's largest electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company: phones, TVs, appliances, lighting, telecom and IT hardware, increasingly components via JVs.

signals.text: Revenue 49.9% CAGR over 5 yrs; last year +25.8%
Operating margin 4.5% → 3.8% (-70 bps)
Other income is 49% of PBT — profit growth leans on non-operating items
Negative working capital (-3 days) — suppliers fund the growth
Debt/equity 0.21
Fixed assets +56% in a year — capacity build ahead of revenue
121% of 6-yr profit came in as operating cash; FCF 29% of PAT
Depreciation +40% last year — new capacity/stores now in the P&L
ROCE 29%, down from a 40% peak
Trades at 36.5× trailing earnings
Auditor draws attention to PLI incentive receivable of ₹1,110 cr — 23.7% of net worth (net 10.8%) — still awaiting determination
15% of quarterly revenue sits in 2 subsidiaries the auditor did not review
Seeks approval for up to ₹4,500 cr a year of sales to Bharti Airtel Ltd — 9.2% of turnover, 1.8× last year's ₹2,497 cr

auditor.document: Limited review of Q1 FY27 consolidated results (31 Jul 2026)

attention.detail: A subsidiary booked ₹1,110 cr of PLI income for over-performance across years; it is still receivable at 30 Jun 2026, pending the government agency's determination. A related ₹604 cr is payable to a customer.

bull.point: Revenue compounded ~50% a year for five years while suppliers fund working capital (−3 days).
Hits the numbers it controls: capex and telecom revenue landed on guidance; IT hardware and FY27 revenue are tracking ahead.
Profits turn into cash — operating cash is 121% of six-year profit — on a light balance sheet (D/E 0.21), with a clean auditor's conclusion.

bear.point: Q1 profit leaned on ₹528 cr of other income, and the auditor flags ₹1,110 cr of PLI income still awaiting government sign-off.
Dates and volumes are unreliable: 0 of 4 capacity dates kept and FY26 phone volumes missed by 18%.
Margin keeps sliding (4.5% → 3.8%, Q1 at 3.0%) while the promised expansion moves out to FY28.

ledger.headline: 2/2 hard numbers kept · 1 target quietly cut
ledger.pattern: Keeps its few hard commitments; the softer targets, like margin, get re-worded downward between calls.

bull.point: A cash machine: free cash flow ≈96% of profit over six years, 81% paid out, debt/equity 0.11.
Did what it said on AI and orders: AI revenue $1.8 bn → $3 bn+ annualised in three quarters; FY26 order book beat the $38–39 bn it guided.
Manufacturing turned in Q2 exactly as guided (+3.1% QoQ in constant currency).

bear.point: Growth has slowed to +4.6% last year from a 10% five-year pace, and operating margin is down 130 bps.
July's 'exit FY27 at 25%+' margin target was gone by October, with Q2 stuck at 24%.
Debtor days up from 67 to 93 and fixed assets +38% in a year — the asset-light model is getting heavier.
